name: Potential Litigation Written Report for Legal Hold
description: When an employee flags a matter that may lead to litigation, the administrator forwards a written report to the Superintendent, who decides with the Solicitor whether to place a legal hold on records.
quote: The administrator shall forward a written report to the Superintendent or designee, who, in consultation with the District Solicitor, will determine whether to place a legal hold on records relevant to the incident(s).
